# Maple Street Community Garden: Member Handbook

## Membership and plots

Membership runs from March 1 to November 30. A standard plot (4 ft × 8 ft) costs $35 per season. A raised, wheelchair-accessible plot costs $20 per season.

Fees are due by March 15. Members who haven't paid by then lose their plot to the next person on the waiting list.

## Watering

Water only between 6 and 9 AM, or after 6 PM. Coil hoses and return them to the hose rack after use.

During a drought warning, watering is limited to Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays.

## Tool shed

The tool shed lock code changes on the first day of every month and is emailed to all members. Return tools clean.

Power tools may only be used by members who have completed the safety orientation, held on the second Saturday of April.

## Compost

Green waste (vegetable scraps, fresh plant trimmings) goes in bin A. Brown waste (dry leaves, cardboard) goes in bin B. No meat, dairy, or diseased plants in any bin.

Finished compost in bin C is free for members to use.

## Volunteer hours

Every member contributes 6 volunteer hours per season. Log your hours on the clipboard inside the shed door. Members who complete fewer than 6 hours pay a $15 fee at the end of the season.
